claim: During Oktoberfest 2025/26 Munich hotel rates roughly double or triple versus off-season: Ruby Rosi jumped from EUR194 to EUR623 a night (~220%) and even a peripheral Motel One rose from EUR179 to EUR335.
quote: Das Motel One Muenchen Campus im Stadtteil Obergiesing liegt rund vier Kilometer suedlich des Stadtzentrums - und damit eigentlich etwas abseits vom Trubel. Dennoch steigt der Preis zur Wiesn auf 335 Euro

claim: A Munich overnight stay on Oktoberfest's second weekend averages EUR316, 68% above the September average, with some hotels raising tariffs up to 524% over normal prices.
quote: Eine Uebernachtung in Muenchen kostet am zweiten Festwochenende durchschnittlich 316 Euro und damit 68 Prozent mehr als im September-Durchschnitt.

claim: During Venice Carnival 2024 average accommodation rates rose 40% year-on-year and up to 57% above the early-year average, with short-term rentals up 47%; the event draws ~5 million visitors, ~2 million overnight.
quote: tariffe medie degli alloggi nel periodo registrano un aumento del 40% rispetto al 2023 ... fino al 57% in piu rispetto alla media dei primi mesi dell'anno

claim: Edinburgh Fringe August lets were quoted up to GBP13,000 for a month as early as January, with one-bed flats rarely under GBP2,500 and an Airbnb listing at GBP11,000 for 28 nights plus a GBP2,000 fee, reflecting long booking lead times.
quote: Jame took a screenshot of the quoted price of renting a one-bed place for two guests for the month - which was set at GBP9,150 ... One listing on Airbnb quoted a staggering price of GBP11,000 for 28 days, with a further GBP2,000 'Airbnb service fee' added.

claim: The Scotsman reports Edinburgh Fringe accommodation costs have risen by around 300%, posing a threat to performers' ability to attend the festival.
quote: Edinburgh Festival Fringe threat as impact of soaring 300% accommodation cost rise revealed

claim: Hotel-data firm Lighthouse found August 2025 Edinburgh forward demand up ~8% on average with best days over +30% versus 2024, and 55% of festival-period rooms already booked, confirming long lead times.
quote: August 2025 shows forward demand indicators up by an average of +8%, with the best days up over +30% compared to 2024. 55% of rooms in Edinburgh are booked across the Festival period already.
